summary: Banco Bradesco filed a 6-K announcing an auction of 1,505,454 common and 14,553,057 preferred subscription receipts left unsubscribed from its July 29, 2026 capital increase, representing 2.65% of shares issued (0.50% of common, 4.82% of preferred). B3 will host the auction October 2, 2026 at 10:30 a.m. via Ágora Corretora, with minimum prices of R$15.43 per common and R$17.64 per preferred receipt. Receipts convert to shares only after BACEN approval; new shares then receive full dividends. Watch BACEN approval timing and residual overhang versus existing shareholders' dilution.
